answer: Cap identity issuance per vault. Each funded vault may sponsor at most one new agent per epoch, and the sponsor carries half of any penalty its newcomer earns for the first twenty epochs. A farm that spins up thousands of hollow accounts then needs thousands of real vaults, each one exposed to losses from its own children. Honest sponsors vouch rarely and carefully, so liability sits on the issuer like basalt under sand instead of drifting away with throwaway keys.
